chunks: With this chain of narrators, Amr al-Ahwazi said: Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) showed me his son and said: 'This is your master after me.'

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad, a title for Imam al-Hadi (peace be upon him)
key_terms.صَاحِبُكُمْ: Your master/owner, indicating authority and leadership

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam al-Hadi (peace be upon him) designate as his successor and the master of the believers?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the explicit designation (nass) of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari pointing to his son as 'your master' (Sayyidukum), a key proof for the Twelver Shia belief in the continuity of Imamate. It underscores the transition of authority within the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the concept of divine appointment rather than mere election.
